scene.note: Femi's three changes leave the working folder one at a time, each on its own way.

steps.note: Femi's edits all sit in the working folder, none of them staged.
Only the finds page goes into the staging area.
The commit holds the new books and nothing else.
The visit page has the phone number with two digits swapped.
The number is fixed in the editor, in the working folder.
The page goes into the staging area as it is now, fixed.
Its own commit saves the right number.
The reading group page is new, and Git does not track it yet.
It moves into the staging area, ready for Wilma to read.
The history does not change until she says yes.
